net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder builder = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.ThumbnailParameterBuilder();
builder.size(10, 10);
builder.formatType("JPEG");
net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = builder.build();

String actualFormatType = param.getFormatType();
assert "JPEG".equals(actualFormatType) : "Expected formatType to be JPEG, but was " + actualFormatType;
System.out.println("__CHECK__ formatType " + actualFormatType);
